Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Marian Jordan is credited on 497 distinct recordings across 7 programs from 1935-10-07 through 1958-11-23. Documented roles include performer on 497 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are Fibber McGee and Molly (performer on 490 recordings; 490 distinct recordings), Lux Radio Theatre (performer on 2 recordings; 2 distinct recordings), Crime and Peter Chambers (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), Lum and Abner (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), The Big Show (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), The Great Gildersleeve (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), and The Lone Ranger (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording).

Documented character portrayals include Molly McGee (490 portrayals) and Teeny (15 portrayals).
